references.text: Jesus performs a similar miracle by feeding 5,000 men, plus women and children, with five loaves of bread and two fish, demonstrating his power over nature and ability to provide abundance from scarcity.
Mark's account of how Jesus fed the 5,000, which parallels the event in Matthew, emphasizes Jesus' ability to meet human needs in supernatural ways.
Luke also includes the story of how Jesus fed the 5,000, showing his compassion and divine authority.
John gives a detailed account of the miracle of feeding the 5,000, highlighting Jesus' ability to provide abundantly and his lordship over creation.
